## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; Industrials, Energy and Financials are strong while Technology is the lone weak sector and several mega-cap techs show short-term weakness — a major divergence (MSFT/NVDA/META/GOOGL). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Industrials); two confirmations for NEUTRAL are broad sector participation plus major mega-cap divergence, so suppress strong directional calls and stay selective.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Industrials lead: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%), RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%), HON ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.21% | 1M: +3.04%). Energy strong: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +8.67%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.32% | 1M: +12.52%). Financials steady: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +9.68%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%). Consumer Discretionary mixed with outsized losers: TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%), AMZN CORRECTION (1W: -7.44% | 1M: +1.93%). Materials showing internal rotation: DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.33% | 1M: -1.91%), NUE RECOVERY (1W: +7.42% | 1M: -0.17%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%), RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%), MMM ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%), T ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +10.38%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Industrials); Style: Value/Cyclical bias given heavy industrials and energy representation.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%), TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -2.40%), PANW CORRECTION (1W: -8.99% | 1M: +8.27%), META CORRECTION (1W: -8.05% | 1M: +9.39%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%). Weakness concentrated in select high-multiple tech and connectivity names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%), RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%), MMM ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%), T ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +10.38%). Watch for major divergence among mega-cap techs (MSFT/NVDA/META/GOOGL) — tactical moves, not broad confirmations.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak; leadership is fractured and several large caps are correcting. AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +22.45%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%), NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%). Sector breadth estimate: Tech: 7/24 positive — internal rotation and headline sensitivity.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive and steady with breadth supportive; JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +9.68%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +11.78%). Sector breadth estimate: Financials: 14/20 positive — supports Value/Cyclical tilt.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive bid but selective; JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%), UNH CORRECTION (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +0.51%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +6.19%). Sector breadth estimate: Healthcare: 12/17 positive — accumulation into names with catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Industrials and select Financials and Energy (LMT, RTX, JPM, XOM) given broad sector participation; reduce exposure to the mega-cap techs showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND signals (GOOGL, MSFT, NVDA, META) and structurally weak names (TSLA). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth in this NEUTRAL, divergent market; monitor for trend confirmation before enlarging positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) — news and guidance confirm upside; UNH CORRECTION (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +0.51%) — earnings/upgrades to watch for follow-through; LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) — monitor order-flow commentary. BEARISH: INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) — structural downside and weak momentum; TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -2.40%) — operational headlines and outages to monitor; TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%) — continued downside risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (estimate 13/15 positive) — leadership and upbeat guidance in aero/defense. BEARISH: Technology (estimate 7/24 positive) — watch mega-cap flows and earnings reaction. Monitor Energy and Financials for confirmation of cyclical rotation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA: reclaiming sustained 1W positive and a return to 1M-positive momentum would be required to exit CORRECTION. AAPL: continued 1M strength (currently ABOVE TREND) is a greenlight for technology exposure; watch for 1W weakness to signal short-term pullback. JPM: hold above recent 1W breakout to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation. RTX: keep monitoring guidance re-rates as a trigger for further upside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
RTX (+80): RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) — guidance raise confirms price action. UNH (+85): UNH CORRECTION (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +0.51%) — profit beat and outlook hike are supportive but price is lagging, watch for follow-through. AMT (+75): AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.07% | 1M: +1.73%) — tower leasing strength is consistent with recent moves (price confirming sentiment).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
XOM (-50): XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.32% | 1M: +12.52%) — analyst downgrade/limited upside commentary diverges from price, watch for distribution. TMUS (-50): TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -2.40%) — outage headlines confirm weakness. INTC (-50): INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) — negative headlines confirm downward price action.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. LMT, RTX and GM showing relative strength and are ABOVE TREND. Key risk is major mega-cap tech divergence (MSFT/NVDA/META/GOOGL) and several news-price divergences (e.g., XOM sentiment vs price) — monitor for trend breaks.
